patthana15.1:2.1: hetuṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na hetuṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuṃ kusalañca na hetuṃ kusalañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi, (cittasamuṭṭhāna meva, arammaṇaṃ natthi.)
patthana15.1:3.1: hetuyā tīṇi, adhipatiyā tīṇi, avigate tīṇi,
patthana15.1:5.1: hetuṃ kusalo dhammo na hetussa na kusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo.
patthana15.1:6.1: hetu kusalo dhammo na hetussa na kusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. tīṇi,
patthana15.1:7.1: na hetu kusalo dhammo na na hetussa na kusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. tīṇi,
patthana15.1:8.1: hetukusalo ca na hetukusalo ca dhammā na hetussa na kusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. tīṇi.
patthana15.1:9.1: hetuyā ekaṃ ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava avigate tīṇi, (pañhāvārampi vitthāretabbaṃ.)
patthana15.1:10.1: hetuṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana15.1:11.1: na hetuṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana15.1:12.1: hetuṃ akusalañca na hetuṃ akusalañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi, adhipatiyā tīṇi, avigate tīṇi,
patthana15.1:14.1: hetuṃ akusalo dhammo na hetussa na akusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo.
patthana15.1:15.1: hetu akusalo dhammo na hetussa na akusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. tīṇi,
patthana15.1:16.1: na hetu akusalo dhammo na na hetussa na akusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. tīṇi,
patthana15.1:17.1: hetu akusalo ca na hetu akusalo ca dhammā na hetussa na akusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. tīṇi.
patthana15.1:18.1: hetuyā ekaṃ ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā ekaṃ, avigate tīṇi,
patthana15.1:19.1: na hetuṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu na abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi, (nissayavārampi pañhāvārampi vitthāretabbaṃ.)
